purpose: Test a necessary computational prerequisite for task-specific low-channel materials sensing using actual raw public measurements, not fully preprocessed spectra.
license: CC-BY-4.0 per publisher README; credit Holt, Khan and Rodrigues
population: Closed-set identification of PE, PET, PLA, PP, PVC and SBR in mixtures at 5%, 15%, and 50% by mass; not trace detection or unknown-material recognition
unit: One raw-spectrum mean per substrate/polymer/concentration; instrumental replicates are not independent specimens
selector: Conventional sequential forward selection using leave-one-training-substrate-out nearest-centroid accuracy; no special GENESIS algorithmic superiority claim
selection: Select classifier per band plan on concrete validation only; select sparse incumbent and full reference on validation only; write frozen plan before test scoring; do not select on test outcomes
inference_boundary: Only selected band readings and fixed training-derived calibration can enter a sparse predictor. No continuum removal, full-spectrum SNV, spectral derivatives or label-conditioned preprocessing.
failure_policy: Report all registered comparisons including failures. Fail closed on checksum, unsupported measurement type, malformed data, missing groups or unavailable source; no fallback to processed spectra or replacement dataset.
interpretation: One prospective workflow holdout, not independently collected new field measurements, a frontier-agent benchmark, physical sensor qualification, measured price reduction or buyer validation.
costs: Record execution CPU/wall, bytes and search counts; total host/model dollars and commercial costs remain unknown. No purchase, paid API, hardware actuation, customer contact or financial-account mutation.
